question: Can public GEO sample age and recorded sex be joined exactly to the qualified GSE136831 donors and their repeated libraries?
decision: Qualify clinical covariate availability before the human numerical freeze; do not treat fields absent from the supplied cell file as absent from all public source records.
strongest_rival: Inexact title matching, subject collisions or conflicting sample/library records would misattribute clinical covariates and distort confounding sensitivity.
discriminator: Exact title suffix removal to Subject_Identity, one-to-one donor/disease matching and many-to-one repeated-library joining; independently parse sample lines and compare clinical values.
exposure_record: Qualification_v1 metadata coverage is exposed. Reviewer identified one sample with age and sex; this session inspected the family metadata title format and characteristic field names before freeze. No new expression fits have run.
biological_unit: Deposited Subject_Identity donor, with Library_Identity and captured cells nested; mappings are to be verified.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells and any repeated libraries nest within source-defined subjects. GSE136831 has already been reused in Ravel; no independent cohort validation is claimed.
population_and_selection: All78GEO sample records in the bounded family SOFT metadata and all78qualified source subjects/107libraries; no fuzzy matching or outcome-driven selection.
contrast: Source-record clinical metadata consistency and coverage; no disease expression contrast.
endpoint: Exact donor/library joins, available age and recorded sex, missingness and conflicts.
methods: Parse GEO family SOFT sample titles and characteristics; exact title-to-subject matching; assert donor and disease sets; independently verify with a separate line-state parser. Preserve raw age/sex values and missing fields.
missingness_and_exclusions: Unknown clinical values remain missing; no imputation or inferred sex/age. Smoking,treatment,lung_function,tissue_region remain unqualified. Missing/ambiguous identity joins stop execution.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or multiple-testing claims.

interpretation_limit: Clinical fields permit descriptive adjustment only; qualification_v1 remains preserved and correct about the supplied cell file. No complete confounder control or biological acceptance.
stop_rule: Stop on hash/order/identity/dimension conflicts and preserve failure records. No expression fits, mouse/infection analysis, engineering protocol or biological intervention in this qualification.
